The [[Inspired Ghostly Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[The Fury]] and [[Guardian of Komalie|Guardians of Komalie]], [[foe]]s in [[The Foundry of Failed Creations]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Inspiration Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell|spells]] (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Enchantments]] last 20% longer
:Two-handed

==Skin==
*This weapon uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ghostly Staff]].
